name: Grok Bot Kit
tagline: Practical Grok Bot tutorials, workflows, and copy-ready bot templates. Independent, source-linked guides from setup to r
description: Grok Bot Kit is an independent tutorial and template site for Grok Bot. It publishes practical tutorials, workflows, and copy-ready bot templates so people can go from first-time setup to real jobs. Guides are source-linked rather than unsourced rewrites. Topics cover setup, productivity, automation, chatbot workflows, and reusable templates. It is not the official Grok or xAI product. Pricing is Freemium, starting at $0.
